mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25% over the next month, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return is expected to be negative due to higher discount rates eroding future earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > (current value + 0.25%) in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the trigger period (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS increase is not confirmed in data.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) by at least 50,000 jobs predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as labor market strength supports corporate optimism.
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 60 days after the trigger, or monthly job growth is not as forecasted.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (retail sales) exceeds 1300 units in two consecutive months, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be positive due to rising consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day return during the two-month high demand window (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) of at least 2 points for three months is associated with a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to weak manufacturing momentum.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < (current value - 2) for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during the three-month weak production period (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 3.5% for a month, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is predicted to be positive as lower labor market friction supports equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day return during the low unemployment window (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their prior month's values by at least 2% each are required to trigger a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return, reflecting dual demand drivers.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous month +2% AND RSAFS > previous month +2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward return not significantly positive when both proxies meet the trigger (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of falling CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 5-day forward return is expected to be positive as lower inflation reduces discounting impact on valuations.
failure_condition: No significant positive 5-day return during the two-month low inflation window (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the combination of GDPC1 (GDP) and INDPRO (industrial production) both fall below their 2022 Q4 averages for the next 20 trading days, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is predicted to be negative, reflecting weak overall supply growth.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 2022Q4_GDP_avg AND INDPRO < 2022Q4_INDPRO_avg for next 20 days
failure_condition: 20-day forward return not significantly negative when both proxies are below their 2022Q4 averages (p > 0.05).
